notes: Calls are fixed — the two sides could never actually connect to each other, so you only ever saw your friend's avatar. Voice and video now work, with a clear message if the mic or camera is blocked. On a computer a call floats over the chat and can be expanded to full screen. Also: the jump-to-latest button now really goes to the newest message, the floating game window has proper margins and can be reopened from the chat, and the main screen fills the whole window.
